mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 61 degrees down by the Verona Public Library.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center has announced they will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27. Additionally, the Water Utility is working with partners to perform essential cross-connection control inspections to keep our water supply safe, so keep an eye out for a letter in your mail.

It is a busy week for events! Today you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, or Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow brings even more fun with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, plus the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat event.

Looking at the weekly police report, on October 25, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a man passed out behind the wheel and subsequently arrested him for an O W I offence.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The store is currently open and serving until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
